G'day all. Just posting another idea to help fight the good fight. Sorry in advance for any spelling or grammar mistakes, I really do try for all our benefit, I can only do my best though.

A bit of reasoning and backstory first:

The voat community at large, will usually do as much as it can within the rules, to protect our ethos of free speech while keeping the majority of users with nefarious intent under control. Voat rules are still young and its users abilities within the rules grow organically. Therefor, some of its baked in rules that were designed to help, and worked fine back in the day, could probably now use a little fine tuning to help keep voat's ethos and rules from being exploited again.

With that said. Some users are using a loophole within the baked in rules to create subverses with high CCP downvoat requirements as a means to hide 'upvoat farms' and or 'alt account incubators', i.e. subverses with a 1 or higher CCP downvoat requirement, will not show in /v/all/new. Also, because the subverses CCP is set so high, if they are ever found and exposed to the voat community, there is no way for the voat community to counter/downvoat any of the users/alt comments within those subverses short of calling on the admin.

I feel that the following solution will help curb these activities or at the very least, keep the act of a user obtaining their first 100 CCP, as transparent as possible.

The fix:

If this step is needed to make this work? Make the CCP total separate from the 'Total Comment Points' or TCP. This will allow the CCP total to fluctuate independently of the TCP.

e.g. use both, TCP and CCP

Simply stop any subverse that has applied more than a '0 minimum CCP requirement for downvoating', from being able to add points to the CCP total.

e.g. a user that receives an upvoat within a subverse with a '1-10000 minimum CCP downvoat requirement' in place, will have a TCP of say (30) and a CCP total of (29).

After a user has obtained (100) CCP, all upvoats in any subverse count towards their CCP total.

The above fix will do two things:

  1. It will stop all new or old users from creating subverses with a CCP limit, just for the purpose of creating upvoat farms or alt account incubator.

  2. All new users looking to get their '100 CCP', will have to legitimately comment in posts that show on /v/all/new, just like everybody else.

Thanks all,
